fact: Car 63 appeared to force Car 16 off the Track at Turn 18
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 b) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video, team radio and in-car video evidence. Car 16 attempted to pass Car 63 into turn 18. Car 63 moved to the left. Car 16 left the track and rejoined in front of Car 63. Both cars were on preparation laps. The Stewards considered that there was nothing dangerous in the manoeuvre and took into account the fact that this was in a Free Practice session.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
evidence presented. ### Garry Connelly Matthew Selley ### Pedro Lamy Steve Pence
title: Decision Car 63 Alleged Forcing Another Driver Off The Track
to: The Team Manager, Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team
